lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the gill slits, organized into approximately five observable horizontal rows with the largest blobs concentrated in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs to form a regular geometric grid pattern across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges extending longitudinally across the upper flank, characterized by high-intensity pixel values on the upper surface transitioning to sharp shadow gradients below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily located near the anterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable indentation or notch on the posterior trailing edge of the visible pectoral fin. Two elongated dark shadows visible ventrally, consistent with remora attachment sites.
